verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service API platform, so data portability is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence shows no documented bulk data export, open-format export, or offboarding feature. Listing accounts via the API is only a developer building block, branded monthly statements are customer-facing documents, and account closure covers end-customer bank accounts rather than a platform user exporting their data and leaving. None of these counts as the export capability itself.
